meta.name: antinet-four-color-cards
meta.description: 财务和投资分析师、律师助理与法律助手在撰写金融研报或分析法律文档时，必用此技能！基于解析文档一键生成事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡与行动红卡。自动完成深度剖析与风险排查，产出100%可溯源的结构化四色报告，让复杂分析高效且严谨。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解析文档,生成四色分析卡,让复杂金融与法律分析高效严谨
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要快速梳理金融研报或法律文档中的事实与风险
copy.tagline_en: Turn complex documents into structured four-color analysis reports for finance and law.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to break down financial reports or legal documents into key facts and risks.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把密卷房解析出的结构化文档转成四张卡片：事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，每张附来源片段；来源缺失时在蓝卡标注「无来源」，不直接生成断言。
howto.when: 在撰写金融研报或分析法律文档时触发，由通政司 Worker 主调用；黄卡交监察院复核过度声明，红卡交丞相府补全；LLM 不可用时降级到规则引擎生成。

say.text: 用四色卡片分析这份文档，先出事实蓝卡
say.note: 对应 extract 阶段，抽取可溯源事实

say.text: 复核这份分析里的过度声明，生成风险黄卡
say.note: 对应 review 阶段，由监察院复核

say.text: 基于这些卡片给出下一步行动建议
say.note: 对应 propose 阶段，由丞相府补全

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude converts a parsed document into four cards: blue (facts), green (explanations), yellow (risks), red (actions), each with source snippets. Facts lacking sources are marked 'no source', not asserted.
howto.when_en: Called mainly by the TongZhengSi Worker when drafting financial research or legal analysis; yellow cards go to JianChaYuan review, red cards to ChengXiangFu, with a rule-engine fallback if no LLM.

say_en.text: Run four-color analysis on this document, starting with the blue facts card
say_en.note: Triggers the extract stage; pulls out facts.

say_en.text: Review this analysis for overclaims and produce the yellow risk card
Suggest next steps based on these cards
